entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure for a UE to request modification, release, or re-negotiation of bearer resources for a traffic flow aggregate, change 3GPP PS data off UE status, or transmit C2 authorization information for UAS services.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure activated when UE requested bearer resource modification is accepted by the network.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure activated when UE requested bearer resource modification is accepted by the network.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation procedure
entities.description: Procedure activated when UE requested bearer resource modification is accepted by the network.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer that does not prevent initiation of UE requested bearer resource modification procedure for 3GPP PS data off status change.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where UE shall not request modification of bearer resources.

entities.name: Change of 3GPP PS data off UE status
entities.description: Condition that requires UE to initiate bearer resource modification procedure regardless of timer T3396 or back-off timer status.

relations.description: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure may invoke dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure when accepted by network.
UE requested bearer resource modification procedure may invoke EPS bearer context modification procedure when accepted by network.
UE requested bearer resource modification procedure may invoke EPS bearer context deactivation procedure when accepted by network.
PDN connection for emergency bearer services condition prevents UE from requesting bearer resource modification.
Change of 3GPP PS data off UE status condition requires UE to initiate bearer resource modification procedure.
Change of 3GPP PS data off UE status condition overrides timer T3396 running or deactivated state.
